id: title:Gilbert09:mobile preserve ordered list start values

review.posthog_relevance: Supports Markdown compatibility for ordered lists starting above 1, allowing users to preserve list numbering rather than resetting to 1.
review.reason: Adds an optional `start` property to the Block interface and its assignment, and updates the rendering of ordered list items to use this stored value. This enables the MarkdownText component to preserve the starting number of an ordered list rather than always starting at 1, supporting Markdown compatibility with lists starting above 1.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to Markdown compatibility and does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or critical path improvement. No tests or migration checks are visible in the supplied hunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
